$comment: Routes ONE package to a newer vcpkg than our pinned builtin-baseline, and leaves every
other dependency exactly where it was.
Why this exists: box3d entered vcpkg on 2026-07-03, and vcpkg.json's builtin-baseline
(170bd3bf...) is pinned to 2026-06-12, so `"box3d"` in the manifest fails with
'the baseline does not contain an entry for port box3d'. The obvious fix -- bumping
builtin-baseline -- would move sdl3, imgui, curl, spdlog and everything else three weeks
at once, in every worktree, for a reason that has nothing to do with physics. A package-
scoped git registry moves only what is named in `packages`.
There is deliberately NO default-registry here: vcpkg treats declaring one alongside
vcpkg.json's builtin-baseline as an error, and the baseline is the more discoverable of
the two places to state it.
The baseline below is an exact upstream commit, so a fresh clone resolves the same
